BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this one word, once, in a picture of himself as a boxer: 'I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air.' The adverb describes running without a clear aim — movement that goes nowhere.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no deep theology hiding in this one; it does plain work in its sentence, and the weight lies with the passage, not the word; in this case, the verse is 1 Corinthians 9:26.
